sentence_stem: If I had studied harder at school,
correct_completion: I would have a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder at school, I would have a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would be earning more money now.
I would be more successful today.

options.text: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a future statement with no link to the past condition in the stem.

options.text: I would have passed the exam last year.
options.why_wrong: This gives a past result, but a mixed conditional needs a present result after a past condition.

options.text: I am studying hard right now.
options.why_wrong: This describes the present activity, not the present result of the past condition.

options.text: I would have a better job now.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past condition with present result
explanation: A mixed conditional links a past condition (if plus past perfect) with a present result (would plus base verb). Polish speakers may keep the same tense in both clauses, because Polish uses one conditional form for both times.
translation: Gdybym uczył się ciężej w szkole, teraz miałbym lepszą pracę.
